name: Lucca Comics & Games
blurb: Italy's largest pop-culture festival, filling the historic city of Lucca with comics, tabletop and video games, cosplay and fantasy art for its 60th/10th-anniversary 'Legacy' edition.

picks: Star Trek, Dawn of the Dead artist

editions.evidence: Official 2026 festival site title/description: "Lucca Comics & Games 2026 | Legacy | 28 ott 1 nov 2026" / "Dal 28 ottobre al 1 novembre 2026 a Lucca"

notes: luccacomicsandgames.com is a year-round 'LC&G 365' hub, not the festival site; the actual 2026 event lives at lucca2026.luccacomicsandgames.com (linked from the hub as 'vai al sito ufficiale'). Its /it/ospiti guest index has 405 confirmed guests across a NUMBERED pager (1-40), not a 'load more' button or infinite scroll -- pipeline/tools/extract.mjs's expandAll() only ever advanced the first ~34 (through surname 'Amati') because it only recognizes English load-more button text AND, separately, has no logic for numbered pagination at all. Both the Italian-button gap and the numbered-pager gap are real, reproducible limits of the shipped tool; a one-off patched copy (clicking the lowest not-yet-visited page number each round) was used to retrieve the full 405-guest cache committed here. Every one of the 405 cards gives only a name, no bio/credit text and no visible category on the card itself; the site's own category chips (Comics/Games/Fantasy/Videogames/Junior/Cosplay/Music/Japan/Movie/Digital) are a client-side filter with no URL parameter, and scripted clicks on them were unreliable (worked once, returned zero guests on retry), so they could not be used to source real categories either. The Cosplay tab in particular seems to hold guests NOT present in the default 'Tutti' (all) view at all -- e.g. Taryn Cosplay, 16th Legio Italica, 501st Italica Garrison and Assassin's Creed Cosplay Italia were seen on that tab but never appeared across all 40 pages of 'Tutti', so this file's 405 picks likely under-count the cosplay guest contingent; their profile pages exist (lucca2026.luccacomicsandgames.com/it/ospiti/<slug>) but could not be captured with a matching photo via the tools used here. Given the complete absence of per-card bio text, cat is 'other' and known for is blank for every guest except ~40 international/Italian comics, fantasy-illustration, author, game and music figures confidently identifiable by name alone from general knowledge (e.g. Frank Miller, Sara Pichelli, Go Nagai, the Hickmans, Licia Troisi); the remaining ~365 are mostly Italian small-press/independent creators this research pass could not verify without guessing, per the 'never guess' rule.
